final: WITH sex_counts AS (SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), stats AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count, SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM sex_counts) SELECT SUM(sc.record_count) AS total_count, AVG(sc.record_count * 1.0 / s.total_count) AS average_share, AVG(sc.record_count - s.avg_count) AS average_excess FROM sex_counts sc CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE sc.record_count > s.avg_count
